dynamics: inherited canonical simplified: Moon point mass + lunar J2 + cannonball SRP (conical penumbra), mu_earth = mu_sun = 0 (D7 spot check excepted)

tracking.range: production two-way range, DSN3, 10 deg mask + lunar occultation, 90 s, station sigma
tracking.ddor_earth_anchor: MEASUREMENT_EPOCH (Earth position and velocity at each grid epoch)

ddor_row_rules.reason: the R1O-D/FXR harness never tested lunar occultation: 93 of 263 canonical FXR rows had the spacecraft behind the Moon for >= 1 station (row count only; no K metric computed before this grid)

geometries.source: campaign epoch + campaign x0 (FXR canonical, GEO G0_consistent)
same J2000/LME state vector as CANON, epoch + 1/4 synodic month
same J2000/LME state vector as CANON, epoch + 2/4 synodic month
same J2000/LME state vector as CANON, epoch + 3/4 synodic month

pairs.note: MC is not a DSN ΔDOR baseline (DSN-210 s2.1.4): reported, excluded from the primary robustness population

OPS_EVERY_WINDOW.rows: 3 normal points (1/6, 1/2, 5/6) per dual-visible window >= 20 min
OPS_EVERY_WINDOW.source: DSN-210 s2.1.4 (~1 h pass), CB13 (3 QSQ normal points/session), DSN-210 Table 9 random RSS 0.048 ns

OPS_TWO_SESSIONS.rows: 3 normal points in the longest qualifying window of each arc half

primary_robustness_population.members: all 9 geometries x pairs {GC, GM} x DENSE_ANGULAR 5 nrad, PRODUCTION_VISIBILITY rows

quasar_grid.kind: GEOMETRY_ONLY_SYNTHETIC_QUASAR, one per session, placed relative to the geocentric spacecraft direction at the session's middle row
quasar_grid.evaluated_on: CANON x {GC, GM} x {DENSE_ANGULAR 5 nrad, OPS_EVERY_WINDOW}
quasar_grid.formal_invariance_check: ΔDOR observable FD with 3 quasar directions on a perturbed trajectory

systematic_models.quasar_coordinate: independent per session (one quasar per session)

bias_cases.B1: common bias on all ΔDOR rows, injected unestimated: nominal 0.033 ns (RSS of DSN-210 Table 8 systematic rows), stress 1 ns
bias_cases.B2: independent per-session bias, sigma 0.033 ns, injected unestimated (RSS K shift)
bias_cases.B3: one delay bias per session solved, no prior
bias_cases.B4: one delay bias per session solved, prior sigma 0.033 ns
bias_cases.weighting: random component only when biases are solved (DSN-210 p. 20): OPS 0.048 ns; DENSE keeps the historical 5 nrad (labelled)

thresholds.relative_gain: delta = f_perp(range+ΔDOR) - f_perp(range) on the SAME geometry: STRONG > 0.05; MODEST (0.02, 0.05]; MAGNITUDE_ONLY [-0.02, 0.02]; DIRECTION_LOSS < -0.02 (R1O-D thresholds + symmetric loss class)
thresholds.absolute_separation: GEO gates: f_perp >= 0.50 STRONG; 0.35-0.50 MODERATE; < 0.35 WEAK
thresholds.rank_and_weakest_mode: SVD of the whitened scaled DESIGN matrix only; normal-matrix rank never used as an observability gate
thresholds.calibration_survival: a case survives nuisance treatment if B3 keeps delta >= 0.02 AND retains >= 50% of its B0 delta

outcome_rules.order: evaluate D first, then C, then B, else A
outcome_rules.D: fewer than 25% of the primary population STRONG
outcome_rules.C: primary population meets A's geometry test but fewer than 50% of it survive B3 in DENSE or in OPS
outcome_rules.B: 25-75% STRONG, or a single geometry family/pair holds all the non-strong cases
outcome_rules.A: at least 75% STRONG, at most 10% DIRECTION_LOSS, at least 50% survive B3 in DENSE and in OPS, and at least 50% of OPS_EVERY_WINDOW cases at least MODEST

fd_cases.rows: the nominal PRODUCTION_VISIBILITY row set, frozen (no visibility re-evaluation)
fd_cases.oracle: independent 6-state re-propagation (lunar_od.dynamics.propagate_state) + production solve_common_transmit_event at the same receive tags
fd_cases.state_gate: every state column: best-step relative error (Frobenius over rows) <= 1e-4
fd_cases.materiality: |f_perp(range + FD ΔDOR) - f_perp(range + analytic ΔDOR)| <= 1e-3; if violated with delta comparable to the science effect -> STOP

surrogate_bridge: every primary case + CANON elevation-only: R1O surrogate on the same epochs

fidelity_spot_check.force_model: GL1800F truncated 50x50 in MOON_PA_DE440 + Earth and Sun point-mass third body (SPICE, scenario epoch) + same SRP; harmonic STM opt-in
cases: the primary-population case with the smallest delta (rule, not choice)
